statement: Arm data center royalty revenue more than doubled year over year, with Neoverse shipments surpassing 1.5 billion cores.
why: Fast growth in Arm data center royalties is a proxy for continued AI rack deployment, since accelerator racks always carry a host CPU layer.

impact.mechanism: Data center CPU royalty growth tracks the number of AI servers being built, and those servers are the same racks that host merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: data center royalty revenue more than doubled year over year

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet restating company disclosures; no primary filing fetched.
